integrity: The universal claim is proved from the defining finite-dimensional Følner test and the source short-exact-sequence theorem; no finite computation is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: No claim is made for noncocommutative Hopf algebras or for a non-field base.
Products, inverse limits, and general non-injective filtered colimits are not proved to preserve extensive amenability.
The originality assessment cannot exclude an unindexed categorical restatement of the same consequence.
title: Extensively amenable modules form a localizing Serre class
